newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Fipe inflation at 0.21 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Fipe inflation at 0.21 pct in March.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.21 percent in March, up from 0.01 percent in February,a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of the Fipe institute, said a 1.59 percent increase in food costs led to higher inflation last month.
In the first quarter of the year, inflation totalled 1.45 percent, he added.
For April, Rizzieri expects inflation to be between 0.2 percent and 0.5 percent.
The president of the Fipe institute also announced the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for March:
- Food 1.59 pct rise in the period
- Housing 0.40 pct rise in the period
- Transportation -0.05 pct drop in the period
- Personal expenses -0.15 pct drop in the period
- Clothing -4.34 pct drop in the period
- Health care 0.38 pct rise in the period
- Education 0.22 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
